'''Borvo's rancor''' was a [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]] owned by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Borvo]]. It was kept in [[Borvo's Vault]] near [[Moenia/Legends|Moenia]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]
[[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="SWG:ORDMBBD" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] entered the vault to retrieve an [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] [[Artificial intelligence/Legends|decentralized autonomy chip]] droid module and was attacked by the rancor.<ref name="SWG:ORDMBBD" />
